Open Roles Role Detail General Information Locations : Vancouver, British Columbia, Canada Role ID 216639 Worker Type Regular Employee Studio/Department EA Studios - SPORTS Work Model Hybrid Description & Requirements Electronic Arts creates next-level entertainment experiences that inspire players and fans around the world. Here, everyone is part of the story. Part of a community that connects across the globe. A place where creativity thrives, new perspectives are invited, and ideas matter. A team where everyone makes play happen. EA SPORTS is one of the most iconic brands in entertainment – connecting hundreds of millions worldwide to the sports they love through a portfolio of industry-leading video games. Building on an incredible 30-year foundation, we’re redefining football with EA SPORTS FC - a genre-leading ecosystem of interactive experiences, bringing a global community of football fans closer to The World's Game. Together, we’re taking the largest football club in the world to new heights – and this is just the beginning! With more opportunities than ever to innovate and create new, authentic experiences that bring joy, inclusivity, and immersion to fans everywhere, we invite you to join us as we pioneer the future of football with EA SPORTS FC and welcome everyone to the club! Our FC Audio team is looking for an experienced Audio Artist who can immediately contribute to audio development. You will oversee the audio-specific project(s) to create/maintain a quality audio experience. You are expected to be experienced with and contribute within all audio design and production phases, with proficiency in at least one audio discipline/area. Experience with VO and technical implementation of game audio are prerequisites. You will report to the Development Manager and work with the Audio leads. If this sounds like you – submit your application and join us on this journey! Responsibilities Create quality audio for our video games, with a high focus on authentic dialogue to suit our story-driven game experiences. Author small, well-defined audio-related tasks with a high focus on content pipelines. Directly support feature(s), small project(s), or task(s) within the Speech discipline, taking ownership of specific game domains. Complete technical implementation, logic, and data-basing tasks, with advanced proficiency in the speech context system and logic methodology. Participate in project problem-solving and troubleshooting with the wider audio and engineering teams. Perform buddy checks, pipeline diffing, and system audits to allow for successful submissions, shelf tests, and stable builds. Manage editor package imports, sample handling, and database updates. Perform Quality Control review for the project's audio (pre-CQC) on all applicable platforms. Create software design to support custom source elements. Manage source control, submit to file depots, and handle build pipelines. Work autonomously to drive features to completion, while contributing to and providing feedback on the overall audio vision. Collaborate in prototyping, driving innovation, and workflow improvements. Provide direction and support to junior speech team members, acting as a mentor and helping onboard new staff. Take direction from Audio Leads, Directors, and other senior stakeholders, while actively expressing your creativity and technical design insight. Qualifications Minimum 5+ years' game audio experience, with a solid background in AAA game development. 7-10 years' studio engineering, recording, and VO production experience (or equivalent). Proven experience in game audio technical implementation, particularly with logic-driven commentary and dialogue systems. High level of proficiency in at least one major audio middleware software (Wwise, Fmod) and familiarity with proprietary game engines. Proficient with modern audio creation equipment, software, and recording techniques, with advanced proficiency in at least one industry-standard DAW (ProTools, Reaper, etc.). Expert-level experience in Microsoft Office tools (Excel, Word, Access, PowerPoint) and Google Sheets, with a proven ability to methodically manage, track, and audit large amounts of metadata and database assets. Solid experience using proprietary game development tools, editors, technology, and build pipelines. Solid knowledge of PC and console audio hardware. Outstanding sound design, dialogue editing, and listening skills. Excellent communication skills, both written and oral, with the ability to collaborate effectively across multidisciplinary teams (Design, Software Engineering, and Production). Strong knowledge of professional sports (specifically Football/Soccer), including leagues, team structures, and commentary styles. Bonus Skills Experience with Quality Assurance Verification, CQC, and in-game debugging. Experience with remote VO recording sessions and directing voice talent. Proficiency with scripting languages (Python, SQL, VBA macros, JavaScript, Lua, etc.) to optimize and automate pipeline processes. Experience leading small feature groups or organizing internal tasks for tracking. Experience using Drone for targeted scenario captures, testing or verification. Ability to troubleshoot CPU and memory audio budgets, manage source control with Perforce and Git, maintain clean asset pipelines, and support methodical asset tracking and databasing. Provide guidance to junior and mid-level audio designers on team workflows and feature deliverables. If you reside in a different location, a recruiter will advise on the applicable range and benefits. jobs.description:
Caltech is a world-renowned science and engineering institute that marshals some of the world's brightest minds and most innovative tools to address fundamental scientific questions. We thrive on finding and cultivating talented people who are passionate about what they do. Join us and be a part of the diverse Caltech community.

#### **Job Summary**

Caltech Academic Media Technologies (AMT) is a film production and event support team providing innovative, creative, and technical solutions for Caltech’s mission-critical efforts in research, education, and outreach.

AMT’s activities include: creating videos and broadcasts for education, outreach, promotion, news, fundraising, stewardship, and internal and external communications; supporting in-person, hybrid, and virtual events for the Board of Trustees, Office of Community and External Relations, academic divisions, campus clients, and JPL; and providing technology, tools, and training for teaching and learning.

This position resides in a fast-paced environment and requires strong technical and creative skills in film and event production, audio-visual, broadcasting, and educational technology support. The ability to work with the AMT team, campus clients, and vendors is critical for success.

#### **Job Duties:**

### **As a member of Caltech's AMT team and reporting to its director, this position will:**

* Design and implement audio-visual solutions for in-person, online, and hybrid events and meetings for various campus spaces and client needs. This activity requires site visits, working with in-room and AMT rented equipment, problem solving, coordinating with vendors, and preparing quotes and invoices. Essential is a strong technical, back-end knowledge of computers, video conferencing and broadcasting hardware and software such as Zoom Meetings and Webinars, Zoom Rooms, Teams Meetings, Teams Rooms, YouTube Live, Wirecast, and similar platforms.
* Setup, operate, and troubleshoot presentation laptops, video conferencing equipment, room control systems (Crestron, Zoom, Teams), computer hardware interfaces (BlackMagic and AJA), and audio-visual equipment including cameras, microphones, audio mixing boards, projectors, speakers, amplifiers, and related audio-visual equipment.
* Create audio-visual signal flow designs for complex events in existing, new, and renovated spaces on and off campus. Work with campus Facilities teams and vendors for audio-visual maintenance, installations, and upgrades.
* Sweeten and mix audio for videos, broadcasts, podcasts, and event recordings. Clean dialogue, reduce noise, repair edits, and balance speech, music, ambience, and effects with EQ, compression, and automation.
* Master audio for delivery of AMT’s audio and video productions for clear, consistent playback. Verify loudness, peak levels, intelligibility, synchronization, and channel configuration; deliver quality-controlled mixes and stems to platform specifications.
* Propose solutions to problems with high energy and a positive attitude and commitment to continual improvement.
* Meet deadlines within a fast-paced environment.
* Work with flexibility, efficiency, enthusiasm, tenacity, and diplomacy both individually and as part of a team.
* Demonstrate commitment to interface with people at all levels at Caltech.
* Maintain a high level of quality control through reviewing, editing, and proofing one’s own work and work of others.
* Remain abreast of relevant industry trends, best practices, and emerging technologies, and effectively apply this knowledge to all aspects of the position.
* Perform work in accordance with Institute and regulatory agencies (e.g. OSHA, ADA) safety standards and practices.
* Keep track of hours worked on projects, events, and tasks, including generating quotes and invoices.
* Other duties as assigned.

#### **Basic Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent in audio engineering, audio production, multimedia, audio-visual technology, audio-visual communications, or a related field of study, with at least 4 years of experience, or Associate’s degree with 7 years of experience.
* Operate audio-visual and recording equipment such as room controls, computers, projectors, cameras, audio boards, microphones and sound systems, and live broadcasting hardware and software.
* Ability to successfully engineer the technical aspects of events and productions which include multiple cameras, microphones, and complex presentation configurations.
* Ability to mix live audio and perform post-production sound design and editing, filtering, noise reduction, compression, EQ, sweetening, and mastering.
* Proficiency with Adobe Creative Suite (AfterEffects, Photoshop, Premiere, Illustrator, Media Encoder, Encore, Audition), Avid Pro Tools, Wirecast, Zoom Meetings, Zoom Webinar, Zoom Rooms, Teams Meeting, Teams Rooms, and similar production and conferencing tools.
* Excellent organizational communication (verbal and written) and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to work calmly under pressure and present an attitude of attentiveness, courtesy, and professionalism when dealing with other team members, trustees, faculty, administration, staff, post-doctoral scholars, students, community, visiting speakers, and event patrons.
* Working knowledge of various computer software (Microsoft Office Suite, Adobe Creative Suite, Zoom, Adobe Acrobat Pro) and operating systems (Mac, Windows, and iOS).
* Exceptional customer service skills.
* Effective and tenacious problem-solving skills.
* Ability to work as a team member on a variety of projects.

* Must be able to bend in all directions, squeeze with arms and hands, crawl under furniture, climb stairs, and work outdoors in all kinds of weather.

jobs.description: To create revolutionary, story-driven RPGs which go straight to the hearts of gamers — this is our mission. Want to dive deeper into our company’s culture? Explore our social media and check out our YouTube channel and Beyond the Game Blog where we share behind-the-scenes insights and stories direct from our team members! CD PROJEKT RED is looking for a Senior Tech QA Analyst - Audio to take ownership of quality, stability and performance across our shared audio technologies. Working closely with Audio Code, Sound Design, Music and QA teams, you will be responsible for validating complex audio systems, investigating difficult technical problems and building effective testing solutions. You will work across C++, Unreal Engine and Wwise, using debugging and profiling tools to understand not only when something fails, but why. As a Senior, you will own complex technical quality topics end-to-end, make risk-based recommendations, develop testing and automation solutions, improve pipelines and practices, and help other QA team members grow their technical capabilities. Responsibilities Oversee the stability, performance, and quality of shared audio systems throughout the entire development lifecycle. Create comprehensive test strategies and coverage plans to identify technical risks early and define effective validation approaches. Conduct deep-dive investigations and root-cause analysis on complex audio issues using C++, Unreal Engine, and Wwise. Monitor and validate audio system performance metrics, including CPU usage, memory, streaming, and runtime behavior. Design and maintain automated testing solutions, functional test environments, and debugging tools to increase investigation efficiency. Work closely with Audio Code and Design teams to evaluate technical solutions and provide data-driven quality recommendations. Drive improvements to testing pipelines, workflows, and QA practices by researching and integrating new testing technologies. Manage technical QA efforts across in-house and external teams to ensure consistent coverage for complex audio features. Elevate team capabilities through clear technical documentation, knowledge sharing, workshops, and mentoring. 5+ years of professional experience in technical QA, software testing, or game development with a focus on complex technical systems. Proven track record of owning quality, stability, and performance for technical features throughout the development cycle. Strong practical knowledge of Unreal Engine and C++, with the ability to read, investigate, and debug production code. Proficiency with audio middleware like Wwise, including technical debugging and performance profiling. Expertise in using diagnostic and profiling tools such as Unreal Insights, PIX, or Razor to analyze performance data, logs, and traces. Experience designing and implementing automated or programmatic testing solutions, pipelines, and internal tools. Skill in designing comprehensive test strategies and coverage plans for technically complex features. Strong understanding of audio programming concepts (DSP, mixing, streaming, voice management) and engine-level performance optimization. Advanced Wwise skills, including integration, optimization, and complex profiling. Experience creating debug levels, instrumentation, or visualization tools for complex systems. Polish lessons for foreign employees — and for your spouse or partner, too. Life insurance — comprehensive pension and insurance plans to protect you and your loved ones. Annual screenings for cancer prevention covered by the company. Psychological and psychiatrist care — free mental health support and various well-being initiatives. Sports card — gain access to a wide number of sporting and fitness facilities across the city. RED Parents Network — support for working parents, including childcare benefits, and family-friendly events. RED Summer Camp for Kids — a fun summer program for children aged 5–12, majority paid by the company. Trainings, lectures, and courses — workshops and trainings for each employee, knowledge-sharing initiatives, online tutorials, and e-learning classes are all available. There’s always something to learn! REDs have access to the cafeteria platform through which they can receive subscription benefits, additional medical packages or vouchers and codes to shops, cinemas, and public transport reimbursement. Gifts for newborn rebels and regular chances to nab some cool swag! Social Activities & Life in the Office Dog-friendly office — dog owner? Social events — we host regular gatherings at the studio where we can all unwind, play games, and just have some fun together. Healthy selections — ​​canteens. jobs.description: Who are we? Tripledot Studios is one of the largest independent mobile games companies in the world. We are a multi-award-winning organisation, with a global 2,500+ strong team across 12 studios. Our expanded portfolio includes some of the biggest titles in mobile gaming, collectively reaching top chart positions around the world and engaging over 25 million daily active users. Tripledot’s guiding principle is that when people love what they do, what they do will be loved by others. We’re building a company we’re proud of. One filled with driven, incredibly smart and detail-orientated people, who LOVE making games. Our ambition is to be the most successful games company in the world, and we’re just getting started. The role is working within our studio: Ludios About Ludios Ludios takes its name from Latin; it means "The Game People". Led by Eyal, one of the co-founders of Tripledot Studios, and some of the most experienced people in mobile games, we are a studio that makes and publishes our own casual, free-to-play mobile games. Our team is based across APAC, with the majority of our development happening in Jakarta and Melbourne. We are data-driven, creative, and genuinely passionate about the industry we work in. Right now, we are working on a number of exciting projects, including one built around a globally recognised IP, alongside several original titles we are equally excited about. If crafting games and reaching millions of players is what gets you out of bed, we would love to hear from you. Role Overview As a Sound Designer at Ludios, you'll be responsible for creating, editing, and implementing audio components for our portfolio of games. You will collaborate with our creative teams to craft an immersive audio experience that compliments the game's visuals and gameplay. Key Responsibilities: Create original and engaging sound design for games, including gameplay actions, user interface interactions, animations, rewards, transitions, and other in-game moments. Take ownership of sound design across multiple features and projects, from initial concept through final delivery. Edit, mix, and master audio to produce polished, balanced results across different devices. Collaborate closely with game designers, artists, developers, producers, and other members of the audio team. Communicate effectively with international colleagues, particularly teams based in London, Barcelona, and Australia. Interpret creative briefs, propose suitable audio direction, and respond constructively to feedback. Review audio within the game, identify areas for improvement, and iterate until the sound supports the intended player experience. Organize audio assets and project files clearly, following consistent naming and delivery practices. Manage priorities and deliver high-quality work within agreed timelines. Contribute positively to team discussions and support a collaborative working environment. Requirements : Strong sound design, sound editing, and mixing skills. A good understanding of audio processing, including equalization, compression, dynamics, spatial effects, and level balancing. Proficiency with at least one professional digital audio workstation. Music composition and production skills Ability to create a complete audio experience using sound effects, audio libraries, voice-over, music, recording, layering, and creative processing. A strong ear for detail, timing, tonal balance, and how sound supports visual feedback and the player experience. Openness to learning and adopting new audio tools, technologies, and workflows. Ability to interpret a creative brief and independently develop an appropriate audio direction. Professional working proficiency in written and spoken English. Strong communication and collaboration skills, including confidence working with colleagues across different locations and time zones. Good organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple tasks or projects. A reliable and constructive approach to teamwork and feedback. Nice to Have Previous experience creating audio for games, particularly mobile or casual games. An understanding of mobile audio limitations, file optimization, loudness, and playback consistency across devices. Experience with collaborative asset-management workflows.
